Class RentalService

java.lang.Object
com.vrms.application.RentalService
public class RentalService extends Object
Provides the application logic required to rent and return vehicles.

This service validates rental periods, prevents double booking, updates vehicle status, saves rental records, closes returned rentals, and calculates rental costs using a rental cost strategy.

      public void setRentalStrategy(com.vrms.domain.RentalCostStrategy rentalStrategy)
      Sets the rental cost calculation strategy.

      This method is used to inject the pricing strategy that will calculate the total cost of a rental when the vehicle is returned.

    • returnVehicle

      public com.vrms.domain.Rental returnVehicle(String vehicleId)
      Returns a rented vehicle and closes its rental record.

      The method finds the rental record using the vehicle identifier, calculates the total rental cost using the selected rental cost strategy, closes the rental record, and changes the vehicle status back to VehicleStatus.AVAILABLE.

      Parameters:
      vehicleId - identifier of the vehicle being returned
      Returns:
      the closed rental record after calculating the total cost
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no rental cost strategy is set or if no rental record is found for the given vehicle
